about.eyebrow.description: Background section — small label above the heading.
about.title: At the pulse of sustainable solutions.
about.lead: Since 2006 I have helped create hundreds of connections related to sustainability and foreign trade — in business management, project management and consulting roles.
about.p0a: I am Martin Brandt, the founder of FinDera Consulting. FinDera grew out of hands-on work with sustainable solutions, sustainable development and international connections.
about.p0b: My background spans several kinds of stakeholder. I have worked on sustainability from a number of different vantage points over my career, which gives an unusually complete picture of what the different players need and what actually works in practice.
about.p1: Working in the public and private sectors as well as in central government sustainability has given me a deep understanding of what different actors need in Finland and internationally — particularly in energy, the circular economy and environmental technology solutions more broadly.
about.p2: I have created hundreds of new connections between organisations and, through them, an extensive personal network in Finland and across Europe. I have also lectured at Aalto University and Åbo Akademi, among others.
about.p3: Broad experience means I can recognise workable solutions and choose the sites that genuinely benefit you — ensuring that every encounter is high in quality, smooth and worthwhile.
about.p4: This background is what FinDera is built on. I find the right players and choose the sites that genuinely benefit you. I open doors, confirm the meetings and shape the encounters so that they produce learning and collaboration.

career.eyebrow.description: Career path — small label above the heading.
career.title: Perspectives from every side.
career.lead: My multi-stakeholder background brings realism, an overall picture and the ability to combine the needs of different parties — I have been, in turn, the client, the deliverer and the broker.
career.1.title: German-Finnish Chamber of Commerce
career.1.desc: As project director I delivered projects and trips for the German Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs relating to energy, the circular economy and export cooperation.
career.2.title: Valonia
career.2.desc: Project director at the Southwest Finland service centre for sustainable development and energy, working at the interface between municipal and business collaboration.
career.3.title: Sweco Finland Oy
career.3.desc: Circular economy development and project manager on the infrastructure side, working directly with clients. Among other things I drew up master plans for circular economy areas.
career.4.title: Motiva Services Oy
career.4.desc: Business manager at the commercial subsidiary of Motiva Oy, the Finnish state's affiliated sustainability body.
career.5.title: Findera Consulting
career.5.desc: I have helped a large number of Finnish companies into German-speaking markets in particular, and created over 100 business connections. Alongside that I have delivered more than 70 study and benchmarking trips.

style.1.title: Approachable
style.1.desc: I know how to meet people. Clients tell me I am approachable, easy to talk to and pleasant company for all participants.

style.2.title: Cultural understanding
style.2.desc: Years of German-Finnish cooperation have taught me how two working cultures are brought together. On trips I also act as interpreter — of the language and of the way things are done.
